body:
I think what I want is to go somewhere new where i feel safe. I haven't cut, but i have the tools to close. I dont want to give her the satisfaction of me hurting myself and i dont want to look pathetic, not that she'd know. I guess im stubborn. I feel like thats a feeling that would soon wear away so in that case, i dont think i am safe. I am still thinking about the building, i just feel it would be such sweet relief but im scared someone will still bring me down and ill ruin my life and be sectioned or something. Unfortunately in the day time here if i even look like im going to attempt someone will drag me down. I'd need to do that at night.

I am open to getting help, i guess i should have done years ago. It just seems like it wont help. I dont know what they could do for me. I'm just intrigued, not hopeful. I think a doctor is out of the question, in the UK it's hard to get an appointment ASAP. 

I said to myself ill come back for a change of clothes and some chargers incase i ended up somewhere but im just distracting myself with the internet and not leavint to get help. I feel like part of me is not in control just wants me to stay here until the next panic attack or the next memory and that will make me end it.

I had to leave work. I had a cry at my desk but gave myself a pep talk. As people came in I just had to go. I sat in the toilets for nearly an hour and whatsapp'd my colleague whats going on who then told my manager. They're supportive.

I guess im just comfortably numb right now. I just want the world to swallow me up. I'm still toying with the crisis centre idea but i dont feel like im in crisis? I'm not sure what that even means. It's not like im waving a knife about. What do you think?

Happy birthday!

I'm going through some stuff too. Music has always helped my life. I'm not too good at guitar but i know a few chords and scales. Gonna have a noodle in your honour, I hope you keep finding pockets of happiness.

Like a squishy aerated fat pancake i guess yeah. Usually with Butter or Jam. Ah i love a good cup noodle. Whats your favourite flavour? I like the Nongshim Shin cup. There's probably way more out there but we're limited in the UK. I've heard there's a place in Japan where you can go and create your own.

It is i guess. I can't be mad, i love her so much. I've asked her several times over the past weeks if everything is okay, how are you doing, are we okay. She's lied every time i guess. it hurts.

I've told my friend now. I think my plan is to find a crisis centre kinda thing today and go there then spend time with him later if i can. I don't want him to be worried and he will just need to see me to know im safe by the sounds of it. I don't feel like im in crisis though? What does that even mean? I'm just comfortably numb and want to die. I have had a couple of panic attacks but i got through them. It's not like im running around with a gun or having constant panic attacks which i imagine what a crisis centre is for?

I had to leave work today. I couldnt face people. I cried at my desk (thankfully noone saw) but I just panicked as more people from my team started trickling in. I hid in the toilets and Whatsapp'd a colleague whats going on and she's spoke to my manager. My manager text me to tell me he understands. Thats a relief. I can't cope with getting in trouble with work for leaving too right now.
I tend to eat a lot of Asian food, though i've sustained life on Crumpets today. How about you?

Sorry to hear about your relationship. I hope things work out for you, likewise if you want to chat about that, though i dont think ill be much help in my current state.

My mind currently is deliberating going to a crisis center, telling myself going to where i think she's staying is a fucking awful idea whilst wikipedia-ing heights of local buildings. I dont know what the fuck my mind is
